entries.title: Psalms 46:1
segments: ¶<To the chief music-maker. Of the sons of Korah; put to Alamoth. A Song.> God is our harbour and our strength, a very present help in trouble.

entries.title: Psalms 46:2
segments: For this cause we will have no fear, even though the earth is changed, and though the mountains are moved in the heart of the sea;

entries.title: Psalms 46:3
segments: Though its waters are sounding and troubled, and though the mountains are shaking with their violent motion. (Selah.)

entries.title: Psalms 46:4
segments: There is a river whose streams make glad the resting-place of God, the holy place of the tents of the Most High.

entries.title: Psalms 46:5
segments: God has taken his place in her; she will not be moved: he will come to her help at the dawn of morning.

entries.title: Psalms 46:6
segments: ¶The nations were angry, the kingdoms were moved; at the sound of his voice the earth became like wax.

entries.title: Psalms 46:7
segments: The Lord of armies is with us; the God of Jacob is our high tower. (Selah.)

entries.title: Psalms 46:8
segments: Come, see the works of the Lord, the destruction which he has made in the earth.

entries.title: Psalms 46:9
segments: He puts an end to wars over all the earth; by him the bow is broken, and the spear cut in two, and the carriage burned in the fire.

entries.title: Psalms 46:10
segments: Be at peace in the knowledge that I am God: I will be lifted up among the nations, I will be honoured through all the earth.

entries.title: Psalms 46:11
segments: The Lord of armies is with us; the God of Jacob is our high tower. (Selah.)
